title: Firestorm
summary: Firestorm is a fire-based spell that functions like a flamethrower. When casting this spell, a sphere of white energy surrounds the user's hand before forming a long stream of flames. This spell is similar in functionality to the Fireswarm spell.

full_text:
Firestorm is a fire-based spell that functions like a flamethrower. When casting this spell, a sphere of white energy surrounds the user's hand before forming a long stream of flames. This spell is similar in functionality to the Fireswarm spell.

History

This spell was used by Marduk, a member of the Blood Spiral, in the Pyramid of the Sun whilst fighting Lok Lambert. Kiel then attempted to use it on Dante Vale and Sophie Casterwill outside the Temple but was distracted by the invocation of Quetzalcoatl. [The Titan in the Temple of Sun]

International Names

French: Tempête de feu
